delivery_area: We deliver within 5 km of the bakery.
delivery_fee: Delivery is Rs 50, free for orders above Rs 1,000.
advance: Orders above Rs 1,000 need a 50% advance by UPI.
cancellation: Cancellation is free up to 12 hours before pickup. After that, the advance is not refunded.
eggless: All our cakes have eggless versions at the same price.
plum_allergens: Plum cake contains nuts and dried fruit.
other_allergens: Cupcakes and chocolate cake are nut-free.
message: A message on the cake is free, up to 20 letters.
candles: Candles are free with every cake.
discounts: Bulk-order discounts need the owner's approval.
weekday_hours: Monday to Saturday opening hours are 9 am to 8 pm.
sunday_hours: Sunday opening hours are 10 am to 6 pm.
